rules.description: An attribute accepts 'allocation' but declares a formula base (allocation is legal only on a direct base).
A base-formula attr node references an id not declared in attributes.items.
An attribute participates in a cycle of the base-formula dependency graph.
A percentage/probability attribute declares no bounds (bounds are mandatory for those domains).
An exponential form's resolved growth_rate is not strictly positive.
A base-formula expression tree is deeper than 32.
A base-formula expression tree has more than 256 nodes.
A polynomial form has 0 or more than 8 coefficients.
A piecewise_linear form has fewer than 2 points, or a lookup_table fewer than 1 entry.
A piecewise_linear/lookup_table form's x-values are not strictly increasing.
A base-formula param node references an id not declared in parameters.
A reserved top-level section is present (refused until its owning issue designs it).
The document's $schema disagrees with the versioned structural schema $id.
A labeled attribute violates its tier's facet pattern (accepts by exact set equality).
An attribute's tier label names no declared tier.
